title: Sykon Aluminium Building Systems — Systems Catalogue

pages.headline: Discover German-engineered aluminium systems built for timeless architecture and real-world performance.
pages.deck: From windows and doors to façades, panoramic sliding systems, and glazed roofs — engineered for reliability and long-term value.

pages.heading: German aluminium systems for modern architecture.
pages.lead: Sykon is among Germany's leading aluminium system houses, developing and marketing premium aluminium profile systems for doors, windows, façades, sliding systems and glazed roofs.
columns:
Every profile and accessory is configured around a standardised, tried-and-tested system concept. That consistency is what makes detailing scalable across projects and keeps technical outcomes controlled from design through fabrication.

Systems are engineered to meet rigorous technical requirements, including advanced thermal insulation and recognised European classifications.

Sykon systems are tested by German bodies and aligned with high safety benchmarks, including fire and smoke protection and security-focused certifications.

Materials, finishes and system choices are selected to support responsible building outcomes and a long service life.
